mentl/5141c43:
Twelve more sites in src/infer.mn restructured:

1. subst_list / subst_params / subst_fields — map((t) => subst_ty(t, mapping), xs).
   The O(N²) `++` accumulator gone; map is the projection.
2. find_mapping — filter((entry) => old == id) + head/-1 default.
3. mint_param_placeholders / mint_params — map over enumerate(params); idx
   threads via the (i, x) tuple, not via a parallel `_at` helper.
   Two `_at` helpers deleted.
4. build_param_types — map over zip(params, handles).
5. build_inferred_params — map((h) => TParam("_", TVar(h), Inferred, Inferred)).
6. register_type_constructors — for_each over enumerate(variants); tag_id
   threads via index. register_variants_at deleted (the loop wrapper was
   the residue when enumerate wasn't reached for).
7. build_ctor_params — map over enumerate(field_types) with base_idx offset.
8. register_effect_ops — for_each((op) => register_one_op(effect_name, op)).

The `_at` and `_loop` helpers were the foreign-fluency pattern when prelude
didn't have enumerate/zip/map/for_each. Prelude HAS them all
(lib/prelude.mn:88-163). Drift-audit clean.

Three wasm GUI bugs fixed:

Canvas had no intrinsic dimensions — eframe defaulted to 300x150, too
small for the 3-column layout. Now sets width/height attributes and JS
viewport sizing so the full INPUT | CHAIN | OUTPUT layout renders.

Input gain and master volume AtomicParams stored linear values (0-4)

did the dB-to-linear conversion.

for the wasm32 target.
